productionBuild.reuseBoundary: Freshly built production source and generated modules remained unchanged through browser qualification. One pre-browser assertion correction changed expected table border-collapse to its existing documented separate-border delivery; no type or production changes.

limits: 59 executed copies per engine means48 gallery modules plus11 complete API modules; all59 copied modules compile against packed declarations.
The two eager scoped color fixtures remain separately authored controls.
The fixture supplies public portable CSS at the URLs declared by the copied source; it never injects a stylesheet omitted by a sample. It omits docs runtime and site stylesheet.
Named consumer journeys are bounded evidence; compilation/mounting does not claim every owning assertion or every reusable public entry.
Native clipboard/AX boundary remains as recorded in earlier gallery receipts; Playwright WebKit is not retail Safari and no speech/manual/native picker evidence is implied.
Remaining public-layer, native Firefox assertion comparison, physical/manual/Safari and separate-owner obligations stay open. Historical external CSS-authoring rerun remains retired, never passed.
